items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: That's Red Car U? I met him.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, you know, Willie Clark, he got killed, uh, he went to the toilet on Mardi Gras, and they killed him, because he had a flash of money.
That's Red Car U. That's Red Car U? I met him. He went, he left here. He beat the woman. And he went to California. Wow. That's why you met him.
No, I didn't meet him. I just got this picture.
